new.name: Beck's Super Bugger
new.description: A woolly bugger with lead eyes, an olive marabou and pearl flash tail, a wound grizzly soft hackle body, pumpkin sili legs and an Ice Dub head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause it for trout, bass and panfish.
steps: Tie the lead eyes on behind the hook eye.
Tie in a marabou tail with a few strands of flash.
Wind a grizzly soft hackle forward as the body and add sili legs on each side.
Dub an Ice Dub head around the eyes and finish.

new.name: Blue Quill Parachute
new.description: A parachute Blue Quill with dun tails, a dark dun calf hair post, a stripped peacock quill body, a dun hackle and a beaver thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in early spring blue quill hatches.
steps: Tie in a stacked calf hair post.
Tie in the tail and wrap a stripped quill body.
Tie in the hackle at the post and dub the thorax.
Wind the hackle around the post and finish under it.

new.name: Bluegill Candy Hopper
new.description: A simple foam hopper for bluegill with tan and chartreuse craft foam and barred yellow rubber legs.
mats: Tan and chartreuse 2 mm craft foam
Yellow and black barred round rubber legs
steps: Cut a tapered foam strip of tan over chartreuse.
Tie it down at the bend and at the thorax.
Tie in rubber legs at the front tie-down.
Trim the foam head and finish.

new.name: Borski's No Name
new.description: Tim Borski's bonefish and redfish shrimp with a tan craft fur tail banded with marker, pearl flash, a grizzly saddle hackle body and lead eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in shallow water with short, slow strips.
mats: Tan craft fur, banded with marker
steps: Tie on the dumbbell eyes so the fly rides hook up.
Tie in a craft fur tail and band it with a marker.
Add a few strands of pearl flash.
Palmer a grizzly saddle forward to the eyes and finish.

new.name: Calder
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a barred mandarin tail, a peacock butt, an orange floss body with gold rib, a brown hackle and a peacock sword wing.
steps: Tie in the mandarin tail and a peacock butt.
Wind an orange floss body and rib it with gold.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Tie the wing on top and finish.

new.name: Carolina Wulff
new.description: A Wulff-style dry with a deer hair tail, a peacock body with a yellow band, white calf wings and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in Smoky Mountain pocket water.
mats: Peacock herl with a yellow floss band
steps: Tie in and divide a white calf tail wing.
Tie in a deer hair tail.
Wrap a peacock body with a yellow band in the middle.
Wind a brown hackle around the wings.

new.name: Clark's Z
new.description: A gold-bodied caddis or stonefly with a poly yarn underwing, a deer hair wing and an olive grizzly hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in caddis hatches and riffles.
steps: Wrap a gold tinsel body.
Tie in a poly yarn underwing.
Tie a deer hair wing over it.
Wind an olive grizzly hackle and finish.

new.name: Clouser Darter
new.description: A darter Clouser in kip tail with a purple underbelly, an olive belly and back, red and purple flash and dumbbell eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along gravel bottoms for smallmouth.
mats: Red Krystal Flash and purple Flashabou
steps: Tie on the dumbbell eyes.
Tie a purple then olive kip tail belly behind and in front of the eyes.
Add red and purple flash.
Tie an olive kip tail back on top and finish.

new.name: Clouser Floating Minnow
new.description: Bob Clouser's floating minnow with a red, white and chartreuse bucktail tail and a body of glued foam spider bodies with eyes under epoxy.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it on top over weed beds for bass.
mats: Red flash, white bucktail, chartreuse flash and chartreuse bucktail
steps: Tie in layers of bucktail and flash as the tail.
Glue two foam spider bodies onto the shank.
Add stick-on eyes.
Coat the head with epoxy.

new.name: Colorado King
new.description: A buoyant caddis with a peccary or moose tail, a hare's mask body, a palmered brown hackle and a deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in fast western water.
steps: Tie in split tails.
Tie in the hackle and dub a hare's mask body.
Palmer the hackle forward.
Tie in a deer hair wing and trim the butts as a head.

new.name: Complex Twist
new.description: A cone head streamer with a barred rabbit tail, UV polar chenille body and twisted schlappen.
steps: Add the cone and lead.
Tie in a rabbit strip tail.
Twist the chenille and schlappen together and wrap them forward.
Stroke the fibres back and finish behind the cone.

new.name: Dirty Rat
new.description: A small parachute with a peacock body, a white post and a grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in a white post.
Wrap a peacock body.
Tie in a grizzly hackle.
Wind it around the post and finish.

new.name: Don King
new.description: A Matuka-style streamer with a brown goat fur body ribbed with wire and a black marabou wing tied down Matuka style.
steps: Tie in the wire at the bend.
Dub a brown fur body.
Lay a marabou feather on top.
Rib through the marabou to bind it down Matuka style.

new.name: Extended Foam Yellow Sally
new.description: A yellow sally with a foam body extended off the hook in segments, an elk wing, thin rubber legs and a dubbed thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in summer sally hatches.
steps: Build a segmented foam body on a needle and tie it to the hook.
Tie in an elk wing.
Add thin rubber legs.
Dub the thorax and finish.

new.name: Grackle
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a red goose tail, a peacock herl body, a black hen hackle and a red goose wing.
steps: Tie in a red tail.
Build a thin wool underbody and wrap peacock over it.
Tie in a black hackle.
Tie a red goose wing on top.

new.name: Gravel Bed
new.description: A Bergman wet fly with a gold tag, a light grey floss body, a black hen hackle and a black goose wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during early season hatches.
steps: Tie a gold tag.
Wind a grey floss body.
Tie in a black hackle.
Tie a black goose wing and finish.

new.name: Green Damsel
new.description: A simple damsel nymph with a peacock sword tail, a gold rib, a green fur body and a green grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie in a peacock sword tail.
Dub a slim green body.
Rib it with gold.
Wind a green grizzly hackle.

new.name: Halladay Adams
new.description: The original Adams as Len Halladay tied it: a golden pheasant tippet tail, a grey wool body, grizzly hackle tip wings tied spent and brown and grizzly hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general mayfly dry.
steps: Tie in grizzly hackle tip wings.
Tie in a tippet tail.
Wrap a grey wool body.
Wind brown and grizzly hackles.

new.name: Henshall
new.description: A classic caddis wet with a gold tip, a peacock sword tail, a peacock body with a white floss rib, a turkey wing and a grizzly hackle.
steps: Tie a gold tip and peacock sword tail.
Wrap a peacock body and rib it with white floss.
Tie in a grizzly hackle.
Tie a turkey wing on top.

new.name: Hot Spot Spider
new.description: A soft hackle with a black floss body, a silver rib, a chartreuse Antron hot spot and a guinea fowl collar.
steps: Wind a black floss body.
Rib it with silver wire.
Dub a small chartreuse hot spot.
Wind a guinea fowl collar.

new.name: Imbrie
new.description: A Bergman wet with a black chenille tip, a yellow floss body, a brown hackle and a slate wing.
steps: Wrap a black chenille tip.
Wind a yellow floss body.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Tie a slate wing on top.

new.name: Jack Schwinn
new.description: A simple bucktail with an orange wool body, a flat gold rib, a yellow bucktail belly and a brown bucktail wing.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Tie in the rib and wrap an orange wool body.
Rib it with gold.
Tie in a yellow bucktail belly.
Tie a brown bucktail wing and finish.

new.name: Jenny Lind
new.description: A colourful Bergman wet with a purple tail, a yellow floss body, a gold rib, a red hackle and a purple wing with a red stripe.
mats: Light purple with a red stripe
steps: Tie in a purple tail.
Wind a yellow floss body and rib it.
Tie in a red hackle.
Tie the married wing on top.

new.name: Jumbo Juju
new.description: A big Juju Baetis-style nymph with a white bead, a brown and orange Superhair body, a black thorax and a mirage casing.
mats: Three brown and two orange strands of Superhair
steps: Slide on the bead and add lead.
Twist the Superhair and wrap a segmented body.
Tie in the tinsel and dub a black thorax.
Pull the casing over and coat with resin.

new.name: Kiffe
new.description: A Bergman wet with a red quill tail, a kelly green floss body, a gold rib, a red throat and a yellow mallard wing.
steps: Tie in a red tail.
Wind a green floss body and rib it.
Tie in a red throat.
Tie a yellow mallard wing.

new.name: King of the Waters
new.description: A Bergman wet with a silver tip, a grey mallard tail, a red floss body, a silver rib, a brown hackle and a mallard wing.
steps: Tie a silver tip and mallard tail.
Wind a red floss body and rib it.
Tie in a brown hackle.
Tie a mallard wing.

new.name: Lady McConnell
new.description: A dry with a grizzly tip and moose tail, a deer hair body and brown and grizzly hackles.
mats: Grizzly hackle tip and moose body hair
steps: Tie in a moose hair and grizzly hackle tip tail.
Lay deer hair along the shank and wrap over it for the body.
Tie in brown and grizzly hackles.
Wind them together and finish.

new.name: Luzerne
new.description: A basic Bergman wet with a dark claret floss body, a mallard flank wing and a black hackle.
steps: Wind a dark claret floss body.
Tie in a black hackle as a beard.
Tie a mallard flank wing on top.
Build a small head and finish.

new.name: Mattress Thrasher
new.description: Bear Andrews' foam-free stonefly with a black dubbed body, a deer hair wing, sili legs, a grizzly hackle and a bright thorax.
steps: Dub a black body.
Tie in a deer hair wing.
Add sili legs and tie in a grizzly hackle.
Dub a bright thorax and wind the hackle through it.

new.name: Mini Hopper
new.description: A small hopper with a black Ice Dub body, an elk wing, orange barred legs and a foam head and wing case.
steps: Dub a black Ice Dub body.
Tie in an elk wing.
Add orange barred legs on each side.
Fold an orange foam strip into a head and wing case.

new.name: Moto Minnow
new.description: A cone minnow with a white marabou tail, an olive guinea fowl body and a white saddle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
mats: Medium gold cone and lead wire
steps: Slide on the gold cone and wrap lead.
Tie in a white marabou tail.
Wind an olive guinea fowl body.
Wind a white saddle collar behind the cone.

new.name: Parachute Damsel
new.description: An adult damsel with a blue yarn tail, a foam wing case, a blue body and a Coq de Leon parachute hackle.
mats: Light and dark blue macrame yarn
steps: Tie a blue yarn extended tail at the bend.
Tie in a blue foam strip for the wing case.
Dub a blue body forward.
Wind a Coq de Leon hackle parachute style and pull the foam over the thorax.

new.name: Pass Lake Special
new.description: A Midwest wet with a mallard tail, a black chenille body, a white kip tail wing and a brown hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for brook trout and panfish.
steps: Tie in a mallard flank tail.
Wrap a black chenille body.
Tie in a white kip tail wing.
Wind a brown hackle in front.

new.name: Pink Pup
new.description: A steelhead streamer with a gold tinsel rear body and pink floss front with a gold rib.
steps: Wrap a gold tinsel rear body.
Wind a pink floss front body.
Rib the front half with gold tinsel.
Tie in a pink marabou wing and finish.

new.name: Pyramid Lake Chironomid
new.description: A chironomid with a copper bead, a black holographic body, an amber wire rib and a red thread thorax.
steps: Slide on the copper bead and tie in the amber wire.
Wrap a black holographic body.
Rib it with the amber wire.
Build a red thread thorax behind the bead.

new.name: Rapid River
new.description: A Rangeley streamer with a silver tag, an orange floss body and a silver rib.
steps: Tie a silver tag.
Wind an orange floss body.
Rib it with silver mylar.
Add a hackle throat and wing and build a banded head.

new.name: Rogue Hex Nymph
new.description: A hex and steelhead nymph with a grizzly marabou tail, a peach Estaz body, a teal hackle, a black shellback and bead chain eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for steelhead and night trout.
steps: Tie on bead chain or mono eyes near the eye.
Tie in a grizzly marabou tail and the Thin Skin.
Wrap a peach Estaz body and pull the Thin Skin over as a shellback.
Wind a teal flank hackle and finish.

new.name: Sheep Creek Special
new.description: A stillwater wet with a rear brown hackle, a peacock chenille body and a mallard flank wing.
steps: Wind a few turns of brown hackle at the rear.
Wrap a peacock chenille body.
Tie in a short mallard flank wing.
Finish the head.

new.name: Sierra Bright Dot
new.description: A fore and aft dry with a tippet tail, a red floss body and grizzly hackles at both ends.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in high mountain streams.
steps: Tie in a tippet tail.
Wind a grizzly hackle at the rear.
Wrap a red floss body.
Wind a grizzly hackle at the front.

new.name: Skip's Dad
new.description: A crayfish with pheasant tail claws, shellback and tail, a red fox squirrel SLF body and a copper rib.
steps: Tie in pheasant tail claws at the bend and a pheasant tail strip for the shellback.
Dub a red fox squirrel SLF body.
Pull the pheasant tail over as a shellback and rib it with copper.
Leave the tips at the eye as a tail and finish.

new.name: Slow Sink Spider
new.description: A chenille spider with white rubber legs that sinks slowly for panfish.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sink and twitch it.
steps: Tie in black and chartreuse chenille.
Wrap a short body.
Tie white rubber legs across the shank.
Wrap more chenille in front of the legs and finish.

new.name: Sparkle Stone Nymph
new.description: A stonefly with an olive bead, split biot tails, a blood leech Simi Seal body and a blue rib.
steps: Slide on the olive bead and wrap lead behind it.
Tie in two split black biots as tails.
Dub a blood leech Simi Seal body.
Rib it with blue wire and pick out the dubbing.

new.name: Stonefly Creeper
new.description: Art Flick's stonefly creeper with a pheasant tail tail, a mono rib, an amber body, a wood duck shellback and partridge legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in Catskill streams.
steps: Tie in pheasant tail tails and the mono rib.
Dub an amber abdomen with a wood duck shellback and rib it.
Dub the thorax and pull wood duck over it.
Wind a brown partridge hackle.

new.name: Suggestive Stillwater
new.description: A jig leech with a marabou tail, a UV olive Brill body, an orange Brill hot spot and a gold bead.
steps: Slide on the gold bead.
Tie in a marabou tail.
Wrap a UV olive Brill body.
Wrap an orange Brill hot spot behind the bead.

new.name: Superfine Sulphur Spinner
new.description: A sulphur spinner with wood duck tails, a pale yellow abdomen, white poly wings and an amber thorax.
steps: Tie in split wood duck tails.
Dub a pale yellow abdomen.
Tie white poly wings spent across the hook.
Dub an amber thorax with figure-eight wraps.

new.name: Tak's Crystal Chironomid
new.description: A clear chironomid with midge tubing, a blue holographic casing and gills and a white head.
steps: Wrap a clear midge tubing body around the bend.
Tie in blue holographic tinsel for the casing.
Add blue tinsel gills and a white Antron head.
Coat the body with UV fly finish.

new.name: Foam Chugger
new.description: A foam terrestrial with rubber legs and a snowshoe hare wing.
steps: Tie in a tan foam strip at the bend.
Fold the foam forward and tie it down.
Add rubber legs at the tie-down.
Tie in a snowshoe hare wing and finish.

new.name: Delaware Adams
new.description: A palmered Adams with an olive body, grizzly tip wings and grizzly and brown front hackles.
steps: Tie in grizzly hackle tip wings.
Tie in a brown hackle fibre tail.
Dub an olive body and palmer a grizzly hackle through it.
Wind grizzly and brown front hackles.

new.name: Psycho Ant
new.description: A big foam ant with a peacock underbody, crazy legs, a black hackle, a flash wing and an indicator.
steps: Wrap a peacock or black dubbing underbody.
Tie foam down over it in two segments.
Add rubber legs and a black hackle trimmed on the bottom.
Tie in a Crystal Flash wing and a white indicator.

new.name: Trude Adams
new.description: An Adams tied Trude style with a moose tail, a grey body, a white calf down-wing and grizzly and brown hackles.
steps: Tie in a moose mane tail.
Dub a grey body.
Tie a white calf tail down-wing over the body.
Wind grizzly and brown hackles in front.

new.name: Turbo Beetle
new.description: A foam beetle with rubber legs, an Ice Dub belly and a white post.
steps: Tie in a strip of black foam at the bend.
Dub an Ice Dub belly.
Pull the foam over and tie it down, adding rubber legs at the tie-down.
Add a white post on top and trim the foam head.

new.name: Yellow Drake
new.description: A vintage wet with a black tail, a gold tag and rib, a yellow floss body, a yellow hackle and a brown mallard wing.
steps: Tie in three black barbs as a tail and a gold tag.
Wind a yellow floss body and rib it with gold.
Tie in a yellow hackle wet style.
Tie brown mallard flank wings and finish a lacquered head.
